decisions.reason: A newly launched classic lever handle line close to the core range, with several models already presented publicly, represents invested tooling and catalogue commitment that management will not abandon after one year.
As a multi-model handle family in the core business that was only just launched, any weak early sales can be attributed to the normal ramp-up in architect specification cycles, so the firm persists.
A single handle design carries less sunk investment than a full family, but it was publicly launched in 2018 and fits the firm's design-led positioning, so it is kept for now.
This single design is close to the established offer and is still within its first market year, so management justifies keeping it while project specifications build.
A lever handle family with several models represents substantial design and tooling investment and visible catalogue commitment, which favours continuing it.
The electronic access system is central to the firm's announced move into digital building organisation, so it is strongly protected regardless of early results.
